scope: Static installed-build world-loading path and local dependencies

order: PreInitLOAD.Start loads InitLOAD in Single mode
stages.caveat: PreInitLOAD is bounded assembly evidence in world-loading-preinit-native.json; built-in ScreenLoader exists before PreInitLOAD.Start.

stages.requirement: Map initial Login allocation sentinel to a concrete available scene; ready response psidglobal is a literal local scene key, not the unique instance ID.

watchdog.failure: Close client and reallocate current scene/instance with isSpaceToLoad=false

stages.client_start: NebulaPlayer.Start -> SetPlayer; local branch sets Memory.LocalNebulaPlayerToConnected, player GUID, input and local PlayerInfo
stages.callback: PlayerLabelInfo request and local NebulaPlayer.LoadAvatar(SessionGUID, OnAvatarLoaded)
stages.risk: OnConnected constructs netId-bearing announcement before WaitUntil, so sending app0 before Mirror spawn can dereference null identity.

stages.dependency: GetPresetGame response must satisfy exact avatar contract, item table catalog and locally resolvable assets
stages.early_position: CreateGhost copies HTTP AvatarInfo.lastPos to the instantiated player root for local and remote players
stages.avatar_complete: PostInstantiateAssets -> End -> clear creation queue/loading flags -> OnAvatarLoaded callback(GUID)
connected_callback: Destroy prior local player if present
stages.local_override: MoveAvatarDelay chooses a serialized Nexus spawn point, applies position/forward/camera, then yields null once
stages.caveat: Uncaught exceptions or missing local resources can prevent callback completion; absence of an explicit reply-count gate is not proof all optional requests are safe to omit.

modern_allocation.result: HTTP direct allocation followed by Mirror is the active traced modern path

legacy_loadbalancer.direct_getter_call: get_Ip called at 0x42ab8c from PS4Info.Init; assigns ipLoadBalancer
legacy_loadbalancer.limitation: E8/E9 byte-position candidates do not cover virtual, indirect, reflection or inlined calls.

local_assets.scene_loader: Local AssetBundle.LoadFromFileAsync; first scene path; SceneManager.LoadSceneAsync
local_assets.modern_asset_loader: Local file/cache; missing bundle returns null; no HTTP fallback
local_assets.shared_dependency_loader: Loads local skinmaterials only; not a generic manifest dependency resolver
local_assets.resources_fallback: Only bounded local filename rewrite for enye-containing item IDs; no HTTP fallback observed
local_assets.optional_missing: s/nexusspaceevent returns null and is skipped
local_assets.legacy_url: Embedded assetbundleserverurl htt[local-path] belongs to legacy AssetBundles manager; active use not established

readiness.claim: Static path reconstruction; no end-to-end or 1:1 runtime equivalence claim

remaining_core_dependencies: Bootstrap identity/session and prerequisite HTTP tasks must produce the exact recovered callbacks; see bootstrap-response-contracts.
Initial Login allocation sentinel must resolve to an available instance and literal scene key.
Mirror identity spawn/component order/payload must match the shipped prefab and precede application opcode0.
GetPresetGame/PlayerLabelInfo, avatar EntryData catalog/assets and avatar completion callback must be valid.
GetAllInWardrobe nonempty responses require the documented copied-client loop fix and PlayerLabelJson elements; empty OK# suppresses callback in the original path.
Local scene, logic, nav, player, UI and skinmaterials objects must deserialize and instantiate in the shipped player; file presence does not establish runtime compatibility.
World occupancy/interactables/state replies and remote presence remain required for restored behavior even though no aggregate reply count gates ScreenLoader.Hide.
limits: Only bounded bootstrap/Nexus roots and their shipped text-manifest dependencies were hashed, not every avatar/housing asset.

All14 built-in boot MonoBehaviour headers resolve; full typetree parsing fails for12 and those errors are preserved. All9 Nexus MonoBehaviour headers resolve; selected loader full-typetree parsing has0 errors.
Ghidra output is native pseudocode, includes merged tails/generic names/indirect-call warnings, and is not recovered original C#.
Legacy absence findings are scoped to the traced modern path and direct-call candidate scan.
No server, listener, game, client or connection was started by this audit.
